newsitem.title: USA: Brookdale cuts shares, price range.
newsitem.headline: Brookdale cuts shares, price range.

text.p: The number of shares and price range for the planned initial public offering in Brookdale Living Communities Inc were lowered, lead underwriter Friedman Billings Ramsey & Co Inc said on Wednesday.

The number of shares were lowered to five million from its original estimate of 6.25 million shares. The estimated price range was cut to $12.50 to $13.50 per common share from $15 to $17. The shares are to trade under the proposed symbol "BLCI" on the Nasdaq National Market.
Brookdale provides senior and assisted living services to the elderly in metropolitan markets.
